description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing User entities, including methods for finding and checking existence by email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: A repository interface extending JpaRepository to perform CRUD operations and custom queries on User entities.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the User with the given email, if exists.

methods.name: existsByEmail
methods.description: Checks whether a User with the specified email exists in the repository.
